text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I will never allow the Everlasting Kingdom 
to become a lost kingdom! For that to 
happen—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As a knight, I must continue to 
demonstrate absolute strength. Winning the 
Sprinters Stakes is the only option!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"None shall escape this Holy Sword 
anymore! Be they a demon general or a 
demon dragon!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff*, three more reps, please. So 
I can decisively cut through, no matter 
how the race unfolds!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even to my eyes, Durandal's current level 
of fulfillment was truly remarkable. With 
this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can cut down any opponent. Especially 
when neither Believe nor Fine Motion is 
running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Sprinters Stakes seemed all 
but assured. However—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible!? Niigata Racecourse is 
stunned! What on earth is this speed!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A landslide victory! Over 1000m of turf, 
no one could even touch her shadow! Is she 
truly an Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O! Blazing through with 
astonishing, super speed!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san...? Trainer-dono, that speed 
just now was..."
choice_data_list: Yeah, I just... can't believe it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The running displayed on the TV screen... 
far exceeded any common sense up to 
now..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O. She didn't appear in a 
single GⅠ this year, but this 
transformation is...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I don't care about the scale of a race. I 
aim for only one thing—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Top Speed"! If you run the absolute 
fastest, the results will naturally 
follow.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I gallop at today's speed, no one will 
be able to catch up to me. Even in a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: A GⅠ... Have you decided on the next race?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes! Don't tell me that 
was the goal all along...?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: No, I just decided now. On a whim.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-san is... stepping up. 
Trainer-dono..."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, they might turn out to be quite a 
formidable rival.

Yeah, they might turn out to be quite a 
formidable rival.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... My "Holy Sword" is sharp enough now 
to cut down even an Umamusume running at 
sonic speed. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Then why are shivers still running down my 
spine? Could it be that Daitaku Helios's 
run just now was...?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, faster than the speed of sound... 
maybe.
Yeah, it might be... faster than sound.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That speed just now... It had long 
surpassed metaphors like 'the speed of 
sound.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A speed unheard of in Umamusume history. 
To put it into perspective...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Speed of light." The current Durandal can 
cut through the speed of sound. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Can one cut through even the speed of 
light? A beam of light accelerated to a 
divine realm, piercing through 1200 meters 
with all its might.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Speed of light"... That's true. Perhaps 
the current Light O-san, at least in 
sprints...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"She might be an even more terrifying 
presence than Believe-san or Fine 
Motion-san."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yet if it is for the sake of the King—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I shall cleave through light itself! 
Trainer-dono, I shall hone this blade's 
edge until it surpasses the very speed of 
light!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Sever the light! Seize eternity! I will! 
I...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sharpness" vs. "Top Speed." Without an 
ounce of exaggeration, this is the 
ultimate battle of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Slash or be pierced. A battle destined to 
go down in the history of the Umamusume 
sprint division was about to begin.
